candidate_evidence.quote: During the lumbar puncture/LP, 20cc will be collected per standard practice in adult patients.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Cohort A will consist of newly diagnosed patients with Glioblastoma.

source_quote.quote: Histologic confirmed glioblastoma (WHO grade IV), IDH wild type per IHC

coder_notes: Diagnostic lumbar puncture only; no drug interventions. Primary aim is CSF cfDNA as a prognostic biomarker (not coded as a tumour biomarker row because no specific molecular marker is named). Two experimental cohorts, neither is a control.
